resources.string: Choose a pin to explore a place and hear its story.
Content could not be loaded. Check your connection or try again.
No places found. Try another name or clear the filter.
The map needs a connection. You can still choose a place from the list.
Map unavailable. Try again or open the list.
Tourist map. Tap a pin for place details.
Choose a narration language and wait for approved content to load.
%1$s is unavailable. Showing %2$s with the same script type.
Location is requested only when you tap Near me or the current location button. No background tracking.
TravelQ1 · Explore places with multilingual narration.
TravelQ1 uses your location to center the map and find nearby places. You can still explore without granting permission.
Location permission is unavailable. Choose a place on the map or search by name.
Location unavailable. Enable location in settings and try again.
No places within 500 m. Clear Near me to explore the map.
Choose a place on the map to read its story and play narration.
Device voice · Timeline uses real audio duration. Audio is cached for faster replay.
Notifications are disabled. You can still listen and enable notifications in system settings.
Audio unavailable. Check the installed voice, connection and storage, then try again.
Changes the interface only. Choose narration language separately.
You are browsing as a guest
Explore and listen without signing in. An anonymous device identity records playbacks. You can sign in with email below.
Code sent by email. It expires in 5 minutes. Check your spam folder too.
New playbacks are recorded for this account. Earlier guest playbacks are retained. A connection is needed to sync playbacks before signing out.
Account connection or playback sync failed. Check your connection and try again.
Incorrect or expired code. Check the 6-digit code or request a new one.
Too many code requests. Please wait and try again.
Email could not be sent. Try again later; you can continue as a guest.
Viewed guides are cached for 60 seconds. Device narration audio uses up to 50 MB and older files are removed automatically. Offline packages are managed separately.
Base content verified and ready to read offline.
Package verification failed. Download again when connected.
Versions checked. Downloads require your confirmation.
Update check failed. Installed content is retained.
New content or an update is available
The map needs a connection. Offline listening requires downloaded audio or an installed offline voice for the selected language.
Download cancelled. The installed version is retained.
Download failed. The installed version is retained.
Text size: %1$d bytes, plus audio. The installed version is replaced only after verification.
Explore, download and listen without signing in. A random installation ID counts Android visitors; no email or hardware identifier is collected.
Use the Tourist Web HTTPS URL or a LAN/emulator backend address.
Enter a valid HTTP(S) URL without credentials or query parameters.
Connected and synced. %1$d listening events remain queued.
Cannot connect. Saved listening events will retry when online.
Verified. Stop the current narration to install, or cancel to keep the previous package.
Optional content removed. Base content is preserved.
Listening is recorded automatically when audio actually plays. No sync button is needed. Offline receipts retry on reconnection, app reopening and every 15 seconds while in use.
%1$d listening receipts waiting to sync automatically.
Some listening receipts could not be saved or sent. The app will retry automatically; check your connection and available storage.
%1$d receipts were rejected and retained for diagnosis. Other valid receipts continue syncing automatically.
The photo could not load. Narration remains available.
This APK has no Android Maps SDK key configured. The location list remains available.
Google Play services is not ready. Update it or use the location list.
